targeted_capacity_research.result: No independently verified nominal indoor capacity accepted in this audit; retailer values and different outdoor-system certificates not used.

limitations: This is materialization of the already authorized v2 evidence, not a new all-brand compatibility discovery.
The numeric BTU bucket is an operational matching aid, never a commercial capacity assertion or compatibility rule.
Existing explicit v2 commercial labels remain unchanged except reviewed Bosch series-token errors; exact Immergas rule tags are added only to the multi context.
Literal BTU-unit labels observed in capacity tables supply global numeric buckets only; no product or compatibility links are inferred from them.
Three Haier REVIVE full BOMs remain valid with partial/unknown per-indoor capacity signatures; a shared total system kW cell is not divided among the indoor units.
Unconfirmed, conditional, pairwise-only and special-scope systems without a confirmed composition rule have no full configuration materialized.
legacy_test_execution_note: All 56 named predicates were reimplemented and executed on v3 with independent source audit; original executable test scripts were not present among mounted inputs. Historical pass flags were not copied.
